tips: Start with a bold hook that mentions rapid growth, e.g., "Apka Business 3x Faster!" especially for reels in Urdu and Arabic
Highlight specific benefits like increased foot traffic and sales for mobile phone shops, bakeries, cafes, and jewellery stores where scores are highest
Use title styles that combine English and local language, e.g., "Supercharge Your Business مع ويب بيلدر" to attract bilingual viewers
Include a clear CTA to WhatsApp with a short phrase like "Message us on WhatsApp now!" and show the number on screen
Avoid static picture posts for POS and autopilot; focus on reels and long videos which have proven higher engagement
